geometry.definition: Head radius: median distance of the template electrodes, projected to the BEM scalp, from the registered centre. Shell radii: median vertex distance in the upper half (z >= 0) of the package frame.

model_selection.criterion: minimum validation mean squared position error
minimum validation mean squared position error

patch_overlap_of_patch_case.algorithm: exact small-cap lens and size pruning
patch_overlap_of_patch_case.footprint: Continuous cap on the unit sphere of directions, half-angle min(diameter / (2 * centre radius), pi).
patch_overlap_of_patch_case.footprint_gap: Smallest angular centre separation minus both half-angles, times the query centre radius; reported only when all query patches were scored and none overlaps a reference patch.
patch_overlap_of_patch_case.geodesic_distance: Angular nearest-centre separation times the query centre radius.
patch_overlap_of_patch_case.iou_reference_scope: All reference patches for each scored query.

report.rss_metric: Peak sampled sum of resident memory over the generator process and its children. Shared pages may be counted in several processes; samples can miss short peaks.
report.timing_scope: Wall time of the whole generator process, from interpreter start to exit, including validation and publication. Stage times are measured inside it; split generation and writing includes the HDF5 append and finalize times.

patch_overlap.geodesic_distance: Angular nearest-centre separation times the query centre radius.
patch_overlap.iou_reference_scope: All reference patches for each scored query.
